data.body: f161 plan-review round 3 = BLOCK (G6). Fixed across 3 rounds, all findings verified against code first: (r1) E6/E2 unrunnable <placeholder> commands; G1G2 - the 3 OPERATOR-ATTESTED RULE statements are SHIPPED prompts (plan_review_F1/E2/E6.md) + coach_moves.py move 14, and docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md is GENERATED/parity-gated, so editing them would break AC-6's 'other clients unaffected' -> scoped all 4 sites OUT with a git diff --exit-code AC; T4 posture -> DET check ships ADVISORY via p6_ac_quality so pre-contract tickets are grandfathered with no migration; G6 -> narrowed the overclaim (environment is repo-refutable, principal/privilege_posture are NOT; inherits ADR-0043 trust boundary); T8 -> no-anchor produces NO finding. (r2) G6/T8 - every activated project.* criterion resolves its rubric from .rebar/prompts/plan-review-project-<name>.md (registry.build_descriptor -> criterion_prompt_id); omitting it = PromptNotFound -> added the file + exec AGENT. E6 - grep -c counts lines not occurrences -> replaced with a structural json.load assertion. (r3) G6 - textual form/location of the 3 fields was unspecified -> pinned as an indented 'provenance:' continuation line binding to the nearest preceding checkbox, with explicit placeholder semantics, and noted ac_item_lines cannot see continuation lines so the new module needs its own scanner. G6 advisory - the 3 neighbour project prompts are execution_mode: single_turn (tool-LESS); tooling is granted by the PROMPT's execution_mode per registry.py, so pinned execution_mode: agentic. Round 4 running.
